name: foodiez
description: Food ordering app built with React, Node.js (Express) and MongoDB
author: Rohit Sharma

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/run-in.mjs backend install && node scripts/run-in.mjs frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan --kill-others "node scripts/run-in.mjs backend run dev:memory" "wait-on --timeout 300000 http-get://localhost:4000/api/health && node scripts/run-in.mjs frontend run dev"
scripts.test: node scripts/run-in.mjs backend test && node scripts/run-in.mjs frontend test
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-in.mjs backend run lint && node scripts/run-in.mjs frontend run lint
